specs.prompt:
Create a finished, exceptionally polished single-page portrait advertising pamphlet for ArticSentinel smart gas monitoring in South Africa. Portrait approximately 2:3, high resolution, suitable for sharing on WhatsApp and printing. It must be a complete designed graphic, not a photo of a leaflet. Crisp readable typography with generous safe margins; professional advertising hierarchy. Use a beautiful animated-movie-style 3D gas cylinder on a slim weighing scale alongside a modern cellphone showing a gas-monitoring app. The cylinder must have a recognisable LPG bottle shape: rounded shoulders, metal protective handle collar, valve, cylindrical body, foot ring. The phone screen must show a simple gas gauge with its orange fill accurately at 23%, a clear "23%" label, a small usage chart, and "Gas running low" notification. This is a friendly stylized product illustration, not a real product photo. Brand spelling exactly "ArticSentinel".
Required exact copy somewhere prominently and clearly, no omissions:
"Low-gas alerts"
"Track consumption"
"Monitor your gas level"
"R2 100"
"Scale & platform engineered and designed in South Africa"
"WhatsApp & cell: +27 66 253 8281"
"articsentinel.com"
"support@articsentinel.com"
Include an accurate small South African national flag beside the South African wording (red upper field, blue lower field, black hoist triangle bordered gold, green horizontal Y bordered white). Do not include the official Proudly South African certification logo. Do not add discounts, guarantees, fees, subscription terms, fake QR codes, unrelated company logos, invented phone numbers or other claims. All text should be correctly spelled, easy to read and neatly aligned. Footer contact details need strong contrast and comfortable size.
Art direction for variant 1: premium spacious ivory and pale icy-blue background, deep navy type and bright orange accents. Sophisticated rounded 3D gas bottle in warm orange and graphite phone, soft studio shadows, substantial hero illustration centered in middle of page. Top small ArticSentinel wordmark. Very bold large editorial headline exactly "Gas run out\nhalfway through cooking?" (render as two or three natural lines without literal backslash characters). Supporting copy exactly "Know before the flame goes out." Three elegant feature labels under the hero with simple bell, chart and gauge icons. Price R2 100 in a striking navy rounded price badge overlapping the hero's lower right. Bottom clean navy contact band with all three contact lines, above it the flag and South African wording. This should feel like a premium contemporary smart-home product launch, clean and beautifully balanced.

first_design_edit: Edit this pamphlet with precise copy and branding cleanup. Preserve the kitchen scene, orange LPG cylinder on its scale, smartphone illustration, overall light blue/ivory/navy/orange style, price, three feature icons, accurate South African flag, and complete contact footer. Replace the headline with exactly "Out of gas\nhalfway through cooking?" using a natural line break. Keep "Know before the flame goes out." Remove ALL invented mountain symbols from header, cylinder, scale and phone. Use only the typographic "ArticSentinel" brand wordmark wherever branding appears. Remove ALL extra handwritten annotations and all extra safety/tomorrow slogans: remove "SMARTER HOMES. SAFER TOMORROWS.", "A smarter tomorrow at home", "More meals More peace of mind", "A SAFER HOME BRIGHTER TOMORROWS", the bottom "A SAFER HOME. BRIGHTER TOMORROWS.", and the blurred writing on the background chopping board. The bottle may retain "SMART GAS MONITORING" below the ArticSentinel wordmark. Clean up the resulting empty spaces elegantly. Make no additional claims. Preserve these exact required lines without spelling changes: "Low-gas alerts", "Track consumption", "Monitor your gas level", "R2 100", "Scale & platform engineered and designed in South Africa", "WhatsApp & cell: +27 66 253 8281", "articsentinel.com", "support@articsentinel.com". Keep all contact text comfortably inside the page and readable. Phone display remains 23% with orange liquid filling approximately one quarter of its cylinder gauge. Deliver finished portrait pamphlet, not a mockup of paper.
